a.lede: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.
a.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps

b.lede: Panay said that it's possible to recover and learn from all sorts of failures, even catastrophic ones, when building products.
b.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay on the importance of failure and bouncing back from it
